description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取跟踪某大陆指数的公募基金列表。可按指数代码批量查询，返回基金名称、基金代码、基金简写名、地区、市场、交易所等数据。当用户想了解某个指数由哪些场内/场外基金跟踪时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain a list of funds tracking a specific A-share index. Supports batch query by index codes, returning fields such as fund name, fund code, fund abbreviation, area, market, and exchange. Call this interface when users want to know which funds track a specific index or filter index-tracking funds.
